name: Gaussian blur
source_description: Gaussian Blur keeps its optimized separable engine instead of adopting an approximation.

name: Box blur
status: Retained from earlier Project Fluidity pass
source_description: True separable uniform-kernel Box Blur. Each axis is a sliding sum with edge-extension; premultiplied RGBA avoids dark contours around cutouts. O(widthheight) regardless of radius, no per-pixel arrays or kernels.

name: Motion blur
status: Retained from earlier Project Fluidity pass
source_description: Full-resolution directional point-spread motion blur, not a generic Gaussian.

name: Radial blur
status: Retained from earlier Project Fluidity pass
source_description: Rotates source samples around an editable image-space pivot.

name: Shock zoom
status: Retained from earlier Project Fluidity pass
source_description: Shock Zoom: a focal bulge with progressively increasing peripheral smear and optional RGB spectral separation. Sample coordinates are in the untouched document space; out-of-range samples clamp to source edges. Dedicated implementation removes 15 inner-loop function calls per pixel.

name: Lens blur
status: Retained from earlier Project Fluidity pass
source_description: Spatially varying polygonal aperture blur, with editable focus and blades.

name: Surface blur
status: Retained from earlier Project Fluidity pass
source_description: Edge-aware surface smoothing. Suppresses local low-contrast variation while retaining hard luminance and chromatic boundaries; source alpha is immutable. The spatial average is a Gaussian, but the bilateral color-distance gate is computed independently per pixel to avoid indiscriminate Gaussian blur.

name: Sharpen
status: Retained from earlier Project Fluidity pass
source_description: A local 4-neighbour Laplacian sharpening kernel. Unlike Unsharp Mask it emphasizes single-pixel boundaries without a large Gaussian halo.

name: Unsharp mask
status: Retained from earlier Project Fluidity pass
source_description: Real unsharp masking: original + strength(original - Gaussian(original)), with user-defined threshold and Gaussian radius. Original alpha is kept.

name: High pass
source_description: High Pass independently implemented, preserving source transparency.

name: Clarity
status: Retained from earlier Project Fluidity pass
source_description: Midtone contrast enhancement on a broad local luminance scale. Shadows/highlights are gently excluded, unlike sharpening micro-edges.

name: Texture detail
status: Retained from earlier Project Fluidity pass
source_description: Fine microtexture enhancement, edge-limited to avoid the broad halos of Clarity and Unsharp Mask. Radius is independently adjustable.

name: Noise reduction
status: Retained from earlier Project Fluidity pass
source_description: Edge-aware color noise reduction. At low local deviation it removes sensor noise; at large differences it retains artwork boundaries. The `detail` control changes the amount of preservation rather than being decorative.

name: Aurora illumination
source_description: Aurora illumination: flowing spectral highlights anchored to artwork pixels. Fully transparent regions remain untouched, unlike a canvas-sized overlay.

name: Radial energy burst
source_description: Energy burst: seeded rays originate at a layer's visible subject bounds, or a user-selected focal point. Empty layers cannot manufacture a random full-canvas starburst.

name: Posterize
source_description: Exact per-channel palette quantization with optional seeded blue-noise-like spatial dithering; the number of distinct levels follows the Levels slider.

name: Cartoon
source_description: Independent cartoon rendering, with real Sobel contours and original alpha.

name: Comic ink
source_description: Independent comic ink rendering, with real Sobel contours and original alpha.

name: Oil painting
source_description: Oil painting: variance-guided Kuwahara color regions and canvas-grain impasto. Six summed-area tables reduce neighborhood evaluation from O(radius² per pixel) to four O(1) quadrant probes. Source alpha is preserved exactly.

name: Watercolor
source_description: Watercolor pigments migrate locally and settle along tonal boundaries. This uses independent bleed, granulation and pooled-edge fields; it is not the Oil Painting color-region selector and never paints empty alpha pixels.

name: Pencil sketch
source_description: Independent pencil sketch rendering, with real Sobel contours and original alpha.

name: Ink drawing
source_description: Adaptive ink illustration: camera luminance is normalized by the source histogram, so dark photographs are not converted to solid black canvases. Sobel contours form the main strokes, shaded regions receive sparse ink.

name: Neon edges
source_description: Neon Edges: Sobel ridge emission, independent luminous color and a configurable spatial bloom. Unlike ordinary edge detection, emission supports outer glow.

name: Chromatic split
source_description: Chromatic Split effect with scanline/channel-specific processing.

name: Digital glitch
source_description: Digital Glitch effect with scanline/channel-specific processing.

name: VHS
source_description: Vhs effect with scanline/channel-specific processing.

name: CRT monitor
source_description: Crt Monitor effect with scanline/channel-specific processing.

name: Mosaic tiles
source_description: Mosaic Tiles: colored tesserae based on local source colors, with adjustable grout thickness. Destination-in preserves the layer's actual alpha silhouette.

name: Swirl
source_description: Swirl inverse-map processing. Image alpha follows geometry.

name: Ripple
source_description: Ripple inverse-map processing. Image alpha follows geometry.

name: Wave
source_description: Wave inverse-map processing. Image alpha follows geometry.

name: Glass refraction
source_description: Glass Refraction inverse-map processing. Image alpha follows geometry.

name: Frosted glass
source_description: Frosted glass: diffuses the image then creates true spatial refraction. Its refraction is spatially correlated, unlike unrelated per-pixel RGB noise.

name: Remove background
source_description: Huelith Cutout: reversible local matte extraction using guided graph cut, conservative border-connected color segmentation, protected/removed brush strokes, edge decontamination and feathering. Source RGB is never erased.

name: Hyper outline
source_description: Hyper Outline (layer version): editable true-distance alpha contour. Advanced gradient/double/electric styles retain the existing subject-outline engine.

name: Spectrum glow
source_description: Spectrum Glow: independent spectrum palette, soft outer/inner illumination, full-resolution distance falloff and luminance-driven bloom for opaque art.

name: Shadow forge
source_description: Layer shadows preserve the editable source and support independent drop, inner, contact, long and perspective shadow geometry per saved entry.

name: Backdrop
source_description: Backdrop is genuinely BEHIND artwork: canvas-sized color or multi-stop gradient filled with its own transform, never a destructive subject tint.

name: Holy Radiance
source_description: Holy Radiance emits genuine directional highlights and a luminous halo originating from the selected subject; it is not an Exposure duplicate.

name: Miasma
source_description: Miasma: procedural dark smoke with turbulent density around the subject, optional wind, and correct premultiplied-alpha overlay composition.

name: Hyper Outline
source_description: Hyper Outline delegates to Huelith's actual multi-ring signed-distance outline engine rather than approximating outline by offsetting transparent copies.

name: Neon Pulse
source_description: Neon Pulse: a true luminance/alpha EDGE emitter with a narrow electric core and separate large-radius bloom. No flat full-canvas cyan recoloring. The phase parameter changes luminosity without changing the source geometry.

name: Shadow Forge
source_description: Shadow Forge: non-destructive displaced contact/soft shadows and turbulent atmospheric tails. The silhouette is derived from the real layer alpha.

name: Dream Bloom
source_description: Dream Bloom emits light only from pixels exceeding an editable luminance threshold. Multiple blur radii yield a soft non-destructive bloom envelope.

name: Glitch Matrix
source_description: Glitch Matrix: seeded block corruption with tracking lines and isolated RGB displacement, not a recolored Digital Glitch preset.

name: Comic Pop
source_description: Comic Pop: independently quantized graphic primaries and tone-dependent mechanical halftone dots, retaining exact source alpha.

name: Frostbite
source_description: Frostbite generates a cyan rim plus seeded crystalline facets at silhouette boundaries. It retains the subject's exact original pixels underneath.

name: Ember Glow
source_description: Ember Glow: alpha-based diffuse heat plus sparse rising ember particles. Ember positions are deterministic for stable slider motion and exports.

name: Prism Split
source_description: Prism Split: real channel-specific directional refraction around subject boundaries. Hidden transparent color cannot pollute the output.

name: Golden Hour
source_description: Golden Hour: selective warm illumination in highlights, blue-shadow suppression and a directional sun-facing exposure gradient.

name: Aurora Flow
source_description: Aurora Flow: curved spectral ribbons built from wave phase and layered color bands. No generic full-frame brightness or uniformly tinted overlay.

name: Electric Edge
source_description: Electric Edge: cyan edge field and forked energy arcs emitted exclusively from actual subject boundaries rather than arbitrary canvas coordinates.

name: Holographic
source_description: Holographic material uses optical-style phase interference and surface luminance modulation, not simple RGB separation.

name: Retro Vision
source_description: Retro Vision: CRT phosphor triads, analog tracking roll and scanline noise. Distant from VHS, which shifts coherent magnetic tape tracks.

name: Plasma Veins
source_description: Plasma Veins: warped filament ridges reinforced by the actual luminance edges of the underlying artwork. Seed and density change the topology.

name: Nebula Bloom
source_description: Nebula Bloom: two-octave cloud scattering and colored luminous haze. Cloud morphology is stable while amount changes for live-scrubbing coherence.

name: Spectral Refraction
source_description: Spectral Refraction: wavelength-dependent directional channel sampling. Unlike a color overlay, displacement comes from actual source coordinates.

name: Rift Distortion
source_description: Rift Distortion warps the image by rotational shear near an editable rift center, preserving the sampled alpha instead of painting a canvas-wide tint.

name: Inferno Aura
source_description: Inferno Aura: nonlinear rising flame tongues augmented by high-frequency source edges. Preserves subject alpha and distinguishes fire from static Glow.

name: Crystal Resonance
source_description: Crystal Resonance: geometric facets with distinct boundary illumination and deterministic face highlights—not random crystalline-colored noise.

name: Liquid Light
source_description: Liquid Light: continuous specular ribbons with nonlinear wave displacement and angle-aware spectral illumination across actual layer pixels.

name: Spectrum Burst
source_description: Spectrum Burst: seeded multicolor rays originate from an alpha-aware subject center rather than the full rectangular document.
